sentences.en: He spoke of the three traits that characterized him most.
sentences.zh: 1. 他说出了最能体现他个性的三个特征。

sentences.en: What character traits would your friends use to describe you?
sentences.zh: 2. 你的朋友们会用哪些性格特点来描述你？

sentences.en: What are three skills or traits you wish you had?
sentences.zh: 3. 你希望拥有哪三种技能或特质？
